tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards and tables.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, header, sidebar, table body, dialogs, inputs, toasts.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Kanban lanes, segmented track, user chip, neutral badges, hover.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on `ground`, `surface`, `surface-sunken` and every `tint-*` (14:1+ light and dark; 21:1 in contrast). Also the text on every light `hue-*` and label fill.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: meta lines, table header, field hints. On `ground`/`surface`/`surface-sunken` (6.3:1+ light, 6:1+ dark, 21:1 contrast).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card borders, row and cell separators. Decorative in light/dark; in contrast it is black so surfaces are set apart by borders, not shade.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons, dashed add-row): 3:1+ on `surface`/`ground`.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The action colour: primary button fill, active tab underline, focus ring, drop target, a11y button.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover; link hover.

tokens.name: primary-ink
tokens.usage: Links and active-nav / selected text on `surface` and `primary-tint` (6:1+ light/dark, 12:1+ contrast).

tokens.name: primary-tint
tokens.usage: Active nav item ground, row hover in tables, drop-target lane.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text on `primary` (5.5:1 light, 6:1+ dark).

tokens.name: hue-tangerine
tokens.usage: Spectrum hue 1 — header strip, logo, spinner. Text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: hue-berry
tokens.usage: Spectrum hue 2 — strip, avatar, KPI bubble.

tokens.name: hue-sky
tokens.usage: Spectrum hue 3 — strip, small avatars, KPI bubble.

tokens.name: hue-mint
tokens.usage: Spectrum hue 4 — strip, toast dot, KPI bubble.

tokens.name: hue-sun
tokens.usage: Spectrum hue 5 — strip, draft banner badge, KPI bubble.

tokens.name: tint-tangerine
tokens.usage: Board chip ground in the sidebar (1st of 5). Text/icon on it: `ink`.

tokens.name: tint-berry
tokens.usage: KPI tile 2 and board chip 2.

tokens.name: tint-sky
tokens.usage: KPI tile 1 and board chip 3.

tokens.name: tint-mint
tokens.usage: KPI tile 4, board chip 4, toast dot halo.

tokens.name: tint-sun
tokens.usage: KPI tile 3, board chip 5, draft banner.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Overdue, errors, destructive buttons; text on `surface`/`danger-tint` (4.5:1+ light, 6:1+ dark, 8:1+ contrast).

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of overdue badges/cells, the overdue KPI tile and form errors.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a `danger` fill.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text on `surface`/`success-tint` (4.7:1+ light/dark, 8:1+ contrast).

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Success badge ground.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of `.badge.warning` (pending / quarantined states). Alias of `tint-sun`; text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 3px keyboard focus ring, 2px offset — 3:1+ on every surface in every theme (contrast: red #c00000, 6.6:1 on white).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs and the item drawer.
